samples.question: The image shows one framed 4x4 patch: rows A-D run top to bottom and columns 1-4 run left to right. Start at the ringed cell. Read the numbered turn markers from top to bottom. A right-pointing marker rotates the token one quarter-turn clockwise around the patch center; a left-pointing marker rotates it one quarter-turn counterclockwise. Apply every turn in order. Which labeled cell contains the token after the last turn?
